propertyExtraction.candidate: CPython 3.13.6 / Unicode 15.1.0, macOS arm64 python-build-standalone via uv
propertyExtraction.method: For every code point from 0 through 0x10ffff, compare complete str.title and str.lower mappings, cased = islower or isupper or istitle, str.isprintable, str.isspace and contextual case-ignorable. For cased characters derive ignorable from (space + char + capital sigma).lower ending in nonfinal sigma; otherwise use (A + capital sigma + char + A).lower having nonfinal sigma at index 1. This derivation exactly matches the CPython 3.12 private C API over the entire domain. The standalone 3.13 runtime hides its private casing/ignorable symbols, so its extraction uses public properties.

publicComparison.cases: All 627 additions plus U+019B, U+1C89, U+1C8A, U+2FFB, U+3000, U+31EE, U+31F0, U+10D50, U+2EBEF and U+2EE5E; each checks percent r, percent a, PY_CAPWORDS(A + capital sigma + char + A) and percent s.
publicComparison.expected: Independent native CPython 3.13.6 percent formatting and string.capwords
publicComparison.result: Zero scalar mismatches. SDK and Shell CSV bytes are identical. Native CSV serialization differs only by quotes around two whitespace-containing fields in the U+3000 row. SDK diagnostics and Shell stdout/stderr are empty; Shell input bytes unchanged.

regression: TDD red: seven selected regressions failed on unsupported 15.1; two selected cases passed and 23978 were filtered. Covers printable boundaries, unassigned neighbors, Unicode 16 negative controls, profile snapshot, typed errors, NUL and budgets.
